title: Datasette Apps: Host custom HTML applications inside Datasette
summary: Datasette Apps is a new feature in Datasette that allows developers to host custom HTML/JavaScript applications directly within Datasette's infrastructure, extending its capabilities beyond data exploration to full-featured web application hosting using its plugin system.
problem_solved: Provides a low-friction way to build and deploy lightweight data-driven web applications without setting up separate web frameworks or hosting infrastructure.
why_valuable: It enables rapid prototyping and deployment of data applications by leveraging Datasette's existing SQLite integration and plugin architecture, reducing infrastructure complexity.
